acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Salesloft's official Drift Sunset FAQ, checked October 30, 2026, says Drift will be retired on January 31, 2027. Your access ends on that date or on the end date of your current contract, whichever comes first.

mainEntity.name: What is the official replacement for Drift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clari + Salesloft named 1mind as its exclusive AI successor for Drift's conversational marketing use case in its official partnership announcement, checked October 30, 2026. Salesloft's sunset FAQ also recommends allGood for Drift Email.

mainEntity.name: Can a new customer still buy Drift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Salesloft's current Chat Agents page, checked October 30, 2026, says it has transitioned from Drift to 1mind. It does not present a public Drift purchase or price path, so a new buyer should evaluate current alternatives rather than plan on a new Drift subscription.

mainEntity.name: What happens to Drift data after retirement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The official sunset FAQ says data for accounts with contracts extending past January 31, 2027 will be stored offline through April 30, 2027 for export requests. Remaining data is scheduled for permanent deletion on May 1, 2027. If your contract ends earlier, access to data ends with that contract unless your account team confirms another arrangement.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free Drift alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: HubSpot offers free live chat, and Tidio and Crisp list free plans on their official pricing pages checked October 30, 2026. These plans have different feature and usage limits, so they are not automatic replacements for Drift's account targeting or sales-routing workflows.
